questions.q: What milestone does the note celebrate?
options: One year of publication of Spirit of Islam
It is for serious readers and seekers of truth and peace.
questions.rationale: … enabling us to successfully complete one year of publication of our magazine, SPIRIT OF ISLAM.

questions.q: How does the article describe happiness?
options: The article calls it a state of mind.
Not a destination but a state of mind
Be happy with what you already have.
A list of things to obtain
The article says conditions prevent happiness.
No material good can give it.
questions.rationale: Happiness is not a destination; it is a state of mind. No material good can give you happiness.

questions.q: Which Quranic image does the article link to the Big Bang?
options: This is not the verse quoted.
This is not the verse quoted.
The heavens and the earth were one solid mass which was torn asunder
The verse is quoted in the article.
The sea that does not mix
This is not the verse quoted.
questions.rationale: Do not those who deny the truth see that the heavens and the earth were one solid mass which we tore asunder?

questions.q: What was broadcast just after the news of Nelson Mandela’s death?
options: The article speaks of his recorded speech.
The speech he gave as President in Parliament on May 10, 1994
The speaker was no more, but his voice could be heard.
The article speaks of his recorded speech.
questions.rationale: The speaker was physically no more, but his voice could still be heard by all without the slightest alteration.

questions.q: What advice did Sachin Tendulkar’s father give him at eleven?
options: “Chase your dreams, but do not take shortcuts.”
He credited his success to it.
questions.rationale: His father advised him: “Chase your dreams, but do not take shortcuts.”

questions.q: Which society does the article call the best?
options: The article calls that the worst.
This is not the measure used.
This is not the measure used.
The worst is a right-conscious society.
questions.rationale: The best society is a duty-conscious society. The worst society is a right-conscious society.

questions.q: What inner quality lets a seed grow into a full-fledged tree?
options: It takes food from everything – soil, water, air and sunlight
A tree illustrates the spiritual life.
This is not in the article.
The article says it draws from everything.
It grows only in rich soil
The article says it takes from everything.
questions.rationale: It is able to take food from everything: from soil, water, air, and sunlight.

questions.q: What is each cycle of movements in salah called?
options: Salah is the second pillar of Islam.
That is a chapter of the Quran.
questions.rationale: Each series or cycle of this movement is called a raka’a (or ‘bowing’).

questions.q: How did Aisha describe the Prophet’s character?
options: Her commentary on the verse “Surely you have a sublime character.”
questions.rationale: Aisha, referring to this verse of the Quran, said: “His character was the Quran.”

questions.q: What do people of understanding say as they ponder creation?
options: This is not in the verse.
‘Lord, You have not created all this without purpose.’
They remember God standing, sitting and lying down.
This is not in the verse.
questions.rationale: ‘Lord, You have not created all this without purpose. Glory be to You! Save us from the torment of the Fire.’
